notes: Background: NovusSearch is a B2B SaaS company that provides site-search + relevance for niche ecommerce customers (mid-size retailers). Looking to replace parts of their in-house reranker with an LLM-based rerank endpoint.
Initial contact: Jordan outbound demo request 2025-11, product team interested in quick win for holiday search relevance issues.

Demo 2026-02-10 (recorded ff_20260210_88a3d6): walked through Hosted API reranking endpoint, offline scoring mode, and eval dashboard. Product lead said 'we like the deterministic rerank scores and ability to run offline scoring at scale.'

POC scope agreed 2026-02-16: 2-week rerank POC ingesting 250k query-doc pairs; evaluate MAP/NRR and latency impact on top-k. Offline batch scoring with hourly job to score historic queries. Offline eval sets provided by Novus (10k holdout queries).

POC success criteria: +8-12% MAP lift on holdout set OR +10% NRR with p95 added latency <120ms for rerank call (hosted). Cost target: < $0.0008 per scored candidate on batch jobs, production per-request cost under defined budget.
Performance notes from demo: p50 ~ 35ms for single rerank call on sample 10-candidate shard; p95 observed ~ 140ms on heavy requests (will test on dedicated), caching requirements discussed.

Integration notes: existing pipeline: retrieval -> feature scoring -> lambda call to reranker -> final score. Novus wants a minimal code change path (SDK + webhooks), and offline scoring output CSV compatible with their batch pipeline.

Security/compliance: needs SSO/SAML for console, SOC2 report requested (uploaded to drive), audit logs for all rerank calls, optional KMS integration for key material. EU data residency for EU customers required (subset), otherwise default public regions acceptable.

Commercials: mid-market pricing sensitivity. Asked for 3 pricing options: pure Hosted consumption, Dedicated reserved vCPU/GPU pool (1yr commit), and Hybrid with burst to hosted. Request sent for 3-tier pricing 2026-02-18 (drive:/deals/novussearch/2026-02-pricing-deck.pdf).
POC deliverables outstanding: POC ingest template + example mapping (drive:/pocs/novussearch/rerank-ingest-template.csv); Redwood to provide sample eval harness and scorecard (Jordan->Priya action).

Quotes from product lead: 'If we can move the offline scoring into a predictable cost bucket and match our QoS targets, we'll push for Dedicated. Hosted is great for POC but we need predictable unit costs for production.'
Support/Jira: raised INF-3421 for custom CSV ingestion mapping; INF-3490 opened for EU region residency questions.
